Here's some steps you can take right now.

Assess your gambling.

Assessing where you are now can help you make informed decisions about what to do next. 

TAKE AN ASSESSMENT

Join the gambling forum.

The forum is a great place to make friends and connect with peers, keep track of your recovery efforts, be inspired and motivated by others, be liberated, share your strategies and help others.

JOIN THE FORUM

Talk to an online counsellor.

Start a chat with an online gambling counsellor. Available 24/7 to help you with any questions you may have about gambling.

CHAT NOW

Do a self-help module.

The self-help program is a series of bite-sized modules that can help you to address different aspects of your gambling. These modules are designed to provide you with strategies and tools to help you manage your gambling.  

START A MODULE

Our Gambling Help Online Forum: Be inspired and motivated by other people’s stories.

It is easier as the days go by, and the kind words and support on this forum has been invaluable.

Thank you all for the support. I woke up this morning with a little bit of the weight off my chest now knowing I have people I can talk to about it. Felt a great relief being able to put it into words and stop lying to myself about it.

Thanks to this community, I don’t feel alone anymore. I thought I was, thank you to whoever set this up. I read so many stories… here. I’ll keep updating this thread about my journey to this gambling detox and rehab.

Today is the start of my challenge. It will be hard but I've seen so many peoples stories and triumphs on here today that it fills me with so much hope and belief in myself and everybody else.
